label: GOD_4 incorruptibility controls: witness, omissions and the tertia via
paraphrase: Closed controls for the GOD_4 incorruptibility composition. (1) Witness: over one being that is GOD_4, all three premises hold, so the result is not vacuous in its antecedent. (2) Omitting 'whatever is GOD_4 is maximal in being': over two beings, one GOD_4, nothing in act, each simply prior to the other, everything able to fail to be; the other two premises hold and GOD_4 can fail to be. (3) Omitting 'the maximum in being is the first being': the GOD_4 being is maximal but the other being is simply prior to it. (4) Omitting 'every first being is simply incorruptible' (the contingent-first-being rival): the only being is GOD_4, maximal and first, and can fail to be. (5) Tertia via control: in a one-being, one-time interpretation GOD_4 is simply incorruptible but possibly at no time, so not NECESSARY_1. Statements about these interpretations only.
